name: Google Calendar Projection Provider
requiresDatabases: Tenant-scoped projection connection, target, event link and failure tables

dataIsolation.guard: Google projection stores only credential references and event mappings; refresh tokens remain in production secret storage and Google event descriptions must not contain private notes, raw source evidence or sensitive financial data.

definitionOfDone: OAuth state binds Portal session, tenant and nonce with exact redirect allowlist
Each tenant has isolated credential reference, targets, ACL, event mappings and failures
Secondary calendars are managed per tenant and per person/company target
Upsert and cancel are idempotent and use stable event links
401, 403, 429, 5xx, timeout and token revoke create failure records
Projection flag off leaves AM/Rental Calendar source records fully operational
